components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Charcoal default for generic high-priority actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Standard secondary action with a solid neutral boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 500 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), border-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--hover); border-color: var(--border-frame); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled 36px field for forms and command bars.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-frame); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus); outline: none; }

components.name: Compact Card
components.description: Default framed working surface for dense application content.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-standard); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-header span { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 12px; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: Compact active route treatment using the neutral selected surface and one consistent solid charcoal icon plate.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-row { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--selected); color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); } .ds-nav-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--selected); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workflow Identity Labels
components.description: Sales and Estimates use labeled teal and berry accents; customer types stay neutral, while ledger-entry color is confined to compact icon plates beside neutral labels.
components.html: ●Sale●Estimate
components.css: .ds-identity-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-identity { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; } .ds-identity-icon { font-size: 8px; } .ds-identity-sale .ds-identity-icon { color: var(--sales-accent); } .ds-identity-estimate .ds-identity-icon { color: var(--estimate-accent); }

components.name: Dense Table Row
components.description: Stable 42px data row with protected numeric alignment.
components.html: Amul Gold Milk 1L2 × ₹72.00₹144.00
components.css: .ds-table-row { min-height: 42px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(110px, auto) minmax(100px, auto); align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-standard); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-table-row:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-table-row:focus-within { background: var(--selected); outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-table-name { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table-meta { color: var(--ink-muted); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table-row strong { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Billing Summary Bar
components.description: Stable transaction footer with an anchored total and one dependable charcoal primary action.
components.css: .ds-summary { height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-frame); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-total { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; } .ds-total span { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-total strong { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-summary-action { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); } .ds-summary-action:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); border-color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-summary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Relay is a compact, keyboard-and-mouse point-of-sale workspace for repeated shop-counter operation. Crisp white working surfaces, a warm neutral canvas, strong charcoal actions, controlled terracotta, teal, berry, and amber accents, and solid borders make the interface feel stable and trustworthy. Density is intentional: common tasks stay visible, financial values are easy to compare, and geometry remains fixed while data changes.
keyCharacteristics: Compact without shrinking text or interaction targets
Neutral working surfaces with solid structural borders
Charcoal billing actions with compact workflow accents
Teal Sales and berry Estimate identities; neutral customer and ledger labels with bounded ledger icon accents
Tabular financial data and stable column geometry
Wide single-line product identification in billing search with stable virtualized rows
Keyboard parity for every billing-critical action
Screen and print themes kept intentionally separate

rules.name: Stable Geometry
rules.body: Primary actions, totals, table columns, and navigation remain in predictable locations across content states.

rules.name: Semantic Color
rules.body: Charcoal identifies primary actions, terracotta identifies focus, teal identifies Sales, berry identifies Estimates, and neutral surfaces keep dense work calm; saved, incomplete, failed, and destructive states retain separate semantic colors.

rules.name: Borders Before Shadows
rules.body: Working surfaces use solid borders; shadows communicate overlays and stacking rather than importance.

rules.name: Keyboard Parity
rules.body: Anything required to create, edit, save, print, or recover a bill is reachable and understandable without a mouse.

rules.name: Print Isolation
rules.body: Receipt and A4 output use invoice-only tokens so screen-theme changes cannot reduce print legibility.

dos: Use semantic tokens and the established density contract.
Keep frequent controls visible and stable.
Design long-name, large-amount, loading, empty, error, and focus states.
Update virtualizer estimates with row-height changes.
Validate the baseline viewport at 100% zoom.
donts: Do not use zoom or transform scaling as a layout system.
Concentrate accents in primary billing actions, compact identity cues, commerce tags, and charts.
Do not hide billing-critical controls behind overflow menus.
Do not rely on hover or color alone for essential state.
Do not let screen colors leak into invoice output.
